description: Hagstova Føroya, the statistics office of the Faroe Islands, publishes its 2011 Census as a folder of the PxWeb statbank, reachable through an open JSON API. The dwellings theme includes a table of dwellings by source for heating, such as district heating, oil or gas, domestic heat pumps, wind or solar and solid fuels, and by cooking energy, cross-classified by dwelling type, floor area, year of construction in bands from before 1919, household type and seven regions. A second table counts dwellings by oil tank age and by septic tank arrangement, separating outflow to an open ditch or river from outflow to a connected drain. The employment theme adds commuting tables, including flows between 118 origin and 102 destination post districts. Coverage is national for the islands. Format and access: open PxWeb API with CSV, JSON and PX output, no registration. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the census is from 2011; most dwelling tables go only to region; household type codes need care when querying totals. Simulation uses: heat pump and district heating uptake, wastewater outfall exposure, and commuting matrices for transport models. Related records: none for the Faroe Islands in the catalogue.

schema_summary: MT148: type of dwelling, type of household (15), year of construction (10 bands from before 1919), floor area (10 bands), source for heating (district heating, oils or gaseous fuels, domestic heat pump, wind or solar, solid fuels), cooking energy (only electricity, electricity and gas, only gas), region. MT150: oil tank age, septic tank facilities (none or shared, outflow to open ditch or river versus connected drain), dwelling type, year built. MT149: parking and cars. MT360: out-commuter and in-commuter post district (118 and 102 codes), age, sex. Other census themes: households, families, rooms, rent, tenure, employment, commuting time and mode.
